goal: Ratify Android custody, artifact, privacy and publication requirements.
description: Scope: Android Requirements.md and target/toolchain catalogs. Context: current workflow selects the wrong target, diagnostics leak metadata and Keystore policy allows unauthenticated persistence. Target: approve REQ-AND-001..004 plus a simulator-build verdict for the Android target. Design Considerations: emulator build/install/launch and simulated authorization are distinct from physical custody and production publication. Design Value: neither a host projection nor an emulator can become hardware-backed Android readiness. Constraints & Risks: Better Plan lacks an Android enum, so every Node explicitly targets Android despite platform any; physical Keystore and real-device encryption remain blocked.

acceptance_criteria.text: All Android labels define observable fail-closed native, physical and channel outcomes.
The Android labels separate emulator build/install/launch and simulated authorization closure from blocked physical Keystore, biometric, encryption and channel evidence.

goal: Reproduce Android workflow, diagnostic, Keystore and physical-evidence blockers.
description: Scope: Android Evidence.md, workflow, Gradle/toolchain, Kotlin bridge, diagnostics and physical script. Context: current source contains deterministic target, privacy and authorization gaps. Target: bind each Android blocker to current source and identify external device/channel gaps. Design Considerations: retain only minimum redacted evidence. Design Value: independent physical verification starts from exact facts. Constraints & Risks: do not read device identity or real account data.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every Android blocker and unverified physical/publication boundary has current redacted evidence.

goal: Freeze Android clean-build, physical, authorization, privacy and publication proof.
description: Scope: Android Validation.md and child receipt schema. Context: current host workflow can infer macOS and no physical proof exists. Target: map requirements to explicit target build, Keystore/BiometricPrompt, diagnostics, independent device install/launch and channel continuity. Design Considerations: device evidence is allowlisted and digest-bound. Design Value: prevents host or fixture evidence from becoming device truth. Constraints & Risks: hardware and store stages remain pending until authorized.

acceptance_criteria.text: Validation covers every Android requirement, negative case and parent/shared dependency id.

goal: Establish explicit Android target, native custody and consented diagnostics architecture.
description: Scope: Android Architecture.md, toolchain/build owner, Kotlin/Rust custody port and diagnostic service. Context: policy and lifecycle side effects overclaim or disclose. Target: typed Keystore strategy, explicit android-arm64 lineage and opt-in bounded diagnostics consume parent contracts. Design Considerations: incomparable custody strategies are not assigned fake levels. Design Value: native truth and artifact truth remain deterministic. Constraints & Risks: child target is Android although schema platform is `any`; remove implicit host inference.

acceptance_criteria.text: Architecture names one owner and failure state for Android build, custody, diagnostics, physical and channel receipts.

goal: Enforce Android user-authorized Keystore custody without silent downgrade.
description: Scope: Kotlin Keystore/BiometricPrompt bridge, Rust capability facts, policy and tests. Context: authentication-mode NONE can become persistent safe custody. Target: authentication-capable devices select an authorized strategy; unavailable protection becomes explicit memory-only. Design Considerations: typed facts, opaque CryptoObject/session handle and bounded authorization. Design Value: satisfies one-flow user authority without weakening cryptographic persistence. Constraints & Risks: background work never prompts and secret bytes never cross generic Flutter payloads.

acceptance_criteria.text: Policy and physical tests cover success, denial, cancellation, lockscreen absence/change, background, delete and restart with no unauthenticated downgrade.

commit.target: Android secure store bridge, facts and policy

goal: Remove unconditional Android diagnostics and add bounded explicit consent.
description: Scope: Flutter lifecycle actions, runtime bridge, storage policy and privacy tests. Context: production appends account, relay, auth and pairing metadata on every startup. Target: no diagnostic output by default; an explicit user action enables an allowlisted protected bounded record with deletion. Design Considerations: fixed schema, size/retention limits and final canary scan. Design Value: production privacy no longer depends on log review. Constraints & Risks: remove the old fixed external JSONL writer completely.

acceptance_criteria.text: Production startup creates no diagnostic by default; consented output is allowlisted, bounded, protected, deletable and privacy-scanned.

commit.message: fix(android): make diagnostics consented and bounded
commit.target: Android lifecycle diagnostics and privacy tests

goal: Make the Android arm64 APK and toolchain deterministic and source-bound.

Target: clean pinned builds emit one verified arm64 artifact and exact manifest. Design Considerations: explicit target selection and content-addressed lineage. Design Value: physical install receives the artifact that CI actually intended. Constraints & Risks: same-source companion CLI is required only when the topology contract names it.

acceptance_criteria.text: Two clean builds use the pinned toolchain and verify target, ABI, manifest, native libraries, profile, signature policy and source lineage.

Design Value: CI orchestration cannot silently validate another platform. Constraints & Risks: physical authorization stays outside unattended build authority.

acceptance_criteria.text: Android job selects android-arm64 explicitly and fails before evidence reduction for wrong target, missing dependency or digest mismatch.
